Simulate and analyze the genetic basis of bitterness in dandelion greens.  
This app lets you explore how dominance, Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, and sampling affect the frequency of bitter and mild dandelions in a population, and helps you understand why observed and expected frequencies may differ in real-world samples.

[Open in a new tab](https://tahirali-biomics.shinyapps.io/AF-dandelion-app/)

[← Back to Interactive Apps](interactive.html)

> This interactive app allows you to:
> - Set the frequency of the mildness allele and sample size, and enter observed counts.
> - Calculate expected and observed frequencies of bitter and mild plants under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.
> - Compare your results and explore possible explanations for discrepancies.
> - Build intuition for how dominance, selection, and sampling affect genetic variation in natural populations.
